title: Temporal accumulation + camera jitter hooks
summary: Add an HDR history buffer and exponential moving average accumulation to reduce noise/flicker; add camera subpixel jitter (Halton) hooks for later TAA.
scope: Add HDR history texture (same format/size as HDR)
Compute pass blends current raymarch output with history using alpha based on step count/noise
Add camera jitter sequence; expose enable/disable
Barriers and lifetime: manage SRV/UAV states for history and HDR
steps: Create history SRV+UAV via DescriptorHeap allocator; track state
In raymarch or a follow-up compute, read history SRV, write HDR UAV with blended result
Double-buffer or ping-pong if needed; swap pointers per frame
Controls: key to toggle accumulation, key to reset history
acceptance_criteria: Visibly smoother image over time when accumulation is on
No state mismatch warnings; clean PIX barriers
History reset works and is logged
Companion Guide: add MCP searches for D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER and FLAGS
